Introduction

When you save a game in the Infinity Engine the .are files for all areas that you have visited are copied to the savegame file. This means that to test anything that changes the .are file you will need to save a game before you enter the area and keep using that savegame as your starting point. For anything else, you can save a game within the area you are testing and a simple reload will update the area. So, what can you and what can't you do without re-entering the area?

What You Can Do (with just a reload)

You can test the following with just a simple area reload:

The light map(s)
The height map
The search map
Wallgroups
Overlays
Area scripts (as long as it is just a change to the script and not a newly-added one)
Trap scripts (ditto)

What You Can't Do

To test the following you will need to enter a virgin (i.e. not visited) area:

Doors
Containers
Actors
Overlays
Area scripts
Traps (including triggers and info points)
Animations
Ambient sounds
